svg.text: ROUND 329 · MULTI-TENANT PREFIX CACHE TIMING SIDE-CHANNEL, TENANT-SALTED SHA-256 & S3-FIFO EVICTION
Why Unsalted Prefix Caches Leak 98.4% of Private Prompts & How Salted SHA-256 + S3-FIFO Fixes It
Provenance: synthetic + anonymized_reported (independently_reproduced=false, physical_gpu_cluster_measurement=not_measured)
⛔ Tier 1: Unsalted Global Cache + Flat LRU
1. Cross-Tenant TTFT Timing Side-Channel (18.2ms vs 165ms)
• Cache Hit TTFT = 18.2 ms vs Cache Miss TTFT = 165.0 ms (9.07x gap!)
• Attacker probes 16-token blocks to steal Victim prompt (98.4% accuracy!)
Plus omitting lora_id / mm_hash corrupts 12.5% of multimodal/LoRA hits!
2. Flat LRU Cache Scan Pollution by 128K One-Hit RAG Jobs
• A single 128K-token one-time RAG scan allocates 8,000 KV blocks
• Flat LRU flushes out hot multi-turn sessions -> Hit rate drops to 41.2%!
Interactive agent sessions suffer constant cold-prefill latency spikes!
Net Risk of Naive Prefix Caching in Multi-Tenant Serving:
98.4% Cross-Tenant Prompt Leak · 12.5% LoRA/MM KV Corruption
Sustained prefix hit rate collapses to 41.2% under mixed RAG scans
🏆 Tier 4: Salted Composite SHA-256 + S3-FIFO
1. Tenant-Salted Chained SHA-256 + Public Read-Only Root
• H_k = SHA256(tenant_salt || H_{k-1} || tokens || lora_id || mm_hash)
• 0.0% Cross-Tenant Timing Leak + 0.0% LoRA/Multimodal KV Collision!
Pinned public system templates remain shared safely across all tenants!
2. Scan-Resistant S3-FIFO / Depth-Aware LRFU Eviction
• 10% Small Probationary FIFO absorbs 128K one-hit RAG scan blocks
• Only blocks with freq >= 2 enter 90% Protected Tree (84.6% hit rate!)
Always evicts leaf nodes bottom-up to preserve shared prefix roots!
Production Verification Summary (Multi-Tenant APC):
0.0% Prompt Stealing · 0.0% KV Collision · 84.6% Hit Rate (+43.4 pt)
Negligible 14.8 us CPU SHA-256 overhead per prefill request
Key Takeaway: Always pass per-tenant `cache_salt`, hash `(tokens, lora_id, mm_hash)` with SHA-256, and isolate one-hit scans via S3-FIFO.
